problem_statement.definition: A sequence a0, a1, ..., at-1 is called increasing if ai-1 < ai for each i: 0 < i < t.
problem_statement.task: You are given a sequence b0, b1, ..., bn-1 and a positive integer d. In each move, you may choose one element of the given sequence and add d to it. What is the least number of moves required to make the given sequence increasing?

input_specification.description: The input consists of two lines.
input_specification.line1: The first line contains two integer numbers n and d.
input_specification.line2: The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the sequence b0, b1, ..., bn-1.

output_specification.description: Output a single integer — the minimal number of moves needed to make the sequence increasing.
